Personal exercise 1: Check the number of bulbul specimens per species available on AVONET
```{r}
AVONET <- read.csv("../data/AVONET raw data.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
str(AVONET)

bulbul_genera <- c("Pycnonotus", "Brachypodius", "Hypsipetes", "Iole",
       "Criniger", "Hemixos", "Alophoixus", "Rubigula",
       "Eurillas", "Setornis", "Tricholestes", "Phyllastrephus",
       "Bleda", "Andropadus", "Stelgidillas", "Calyptocichla", 
       "Neolestes", "Atimastillas", "Alcurus", "Nok", "Spizixos",
       "Ixonotus", "Thescelocichla", "Chlorocichla", "Baeopogon", 
       "Arizelocichla", "Acritillas", "Ixos", "Microtarsus")

AVONET$Species2_eBird <- trimws(as.character(AVONET$Species2_eBird))
pattern <- paste0("^(", paste(bulbul_genera, collapse = "|"), ")(\\b|\\s)")

idx <- !is.na(AVONET$Species2_eBird) & grepl(pattern, AVONET$Species2_eBird, ignore.case = TRUE)
bulbuls <- AVONET[idx, ]
str(bulbuls)

# Only keep species that have at least 4 entries
bulbuls_count <- table(bulbuls$Species2_eBird)
bulbuls <- bulbuls[bulbuls$Species2_eBird %in% names(bulbuls_count[bulbuls_count >= 5]), ]

bulbuls <- read.csv("../data/Bulbul_AVONET_data.csv")
str(bulbuls)
unique(bulbuls$AviList)

bulbuls_var <- bulbuls %>%
  group_by(AviList) %>%
  summarise(
    n_specimens = n(),
    across(
      all_of(trait_cols),
      list(
        Mean = ~ if(sum(!is.na(.)) == 0) NA_real_ else mean(., na.rm = TRUE),
        Max  = ~ if(sum(!is.na(.)) == 0) NA_real_ else max(., na.rm = TRUE),
        Min  = ~ if(sum(!is.na(.)) == 0) NA_real_ else min(., na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Save the trait variance data
write.csv(bulbuls_var, "../data/Bulbul_trait_data.csv")

# Ensure Specimen.number is character and trimmed
bulbuls$Specimen.number <- trimws(as.character(bulbuls$Specimen.number))

# Drop rows with missing/empty specimen numbers
bulbuls <- bulbuls[!is.na(bulbuls$Specimen.number) & bulbuls$Specimen.number != "", ]

# Keep only one row per unique specimen number within each species
bulbuls <- bulbuls[!duplicated(paste(bulbuls$Species2_eBird, bulbuls$Specimen.number)), ]
str(bulbuls)

bul_count <- table(bulbuls$Species2_eBird)
mean(bul_count)
hist(bul_count, main = "Frequency of individual specimens sampled per species", xlab = "No. of individuals sampled")

write.csv(bul_count, "../data/Bulbul_specimen_counts_4_or_less.csv")
bul_count <- bul_count[bul_count <= 4]

#Calculate specimen counts again from Bulbul_AVONET_data.csv to check

bul_count <- table(bulbuls$AviList)
bul_count <- bul_count[bul_count <= 9]
write.csv(bul_count, "../data/Bulbul_specimen_counts_less_than_10.csv")

setdiff(
  unique(avilist_bulbuls$Scientific_name),
  unique(bulbul_avonet$Species1_BirdLife)
)

setdiff(
  unique(bulbul_avonet$Species1_BirdLife),
  unique(avilist_bulbuls$Scientific_name)
)
```
Looking at holdings of bulbuls in the KU collection
```{r}
ku_holdings <- read.csv("../data/Holdings/ku_pycnonotidae.csv")
str(ku_holdings)

#Combine columns 5 and 6 to get full scientific name and add a space in between
ku_holdings$Scientific_name <- paste(ku_holdings$Genus...Full.Name, ku_holdings$Species...Full.Name, sep = " ")
str(ku_holdings)

ku_bulcount <- table(ku_holdings$Scientific_name)

bulcount <- read.csv("../data/Bulbul_specimen_counts.csv")

#Add the specimen counts from the bulcount data frame to a new column in the ku_bulcount data frame, matching by scientific name
ku_bulcount <- as.data.frame(ku_bulcount)
ku_bulcount <- ku_bulcount |>
  left_join(bulcount, by = c("Var1" = "Var1"))

write.csv(ku_bulcount, "../data/Holdings/KU_priority_list.csv")

#Next holding: WFVZ
wfvz_holdings <- read.xlsx("../data/Holdings/WFVZ Pycnonotidae Study Skins.xlsx")
str(wfvz_holdings)
#If column NEWGENUS is not empty, combine it with column NEWSPECIES to get the full scientific name. If NEWGENUS is empty, use the GENUS and SPECIES columns instead
wfvz_holdings$Scientific_name <- ifelse(
  !is.na(wfvz_holdings$NEWGENUS) & !is.na(wfvz_holdings$NEWSPECIES),
  paste(wfvz_holdings$NEWGENUS, wfvz_holdings$NEWSPECIES, sep = " "),
  ifelse(
    !is.na(wfvz_holdings$NEWGENUS) & is.na(wfvz_holdings$NEWSPECIES),
    paste(wfvz_holdings$NEWGENUS, wfvz_holdings$SPECIES, sep = " "),
    ifelse(
      is.na(wfvz_holdings$NEWGENUS) & !is.na(wfvz_holdings$NEWSPECIES),
      paste(wfvz_holdings$GENUS, wfvz_holdings$NEWSPECIES, sep = " "),
      paste(wfvz_holdings$GENUS, wfvz_holdings$SPECIES, sep = " ")
    )
  )
)

str(wfvz_holdings)

#Make a count table of the number of specimens per species in the wfvz_holdings data frame
wfvz_bulcount <- table(wfvz_holdings$Scientific_name)

#Check differences between the scientific names in the wfvz_holdings data frame and ku_holdings data frame
setdiff(
  unique(wfvz_holdings$Scientific_name),
  unique(ku_bulcount$Var1)
)

setdiff(
  unique(ku_bulcount$Var1),
  unique(wfvz_holdings$Scientific_name)
)

#Now only keep the species present in both data frames in the wfvz_holdings data frame
wfvz_holdings <- wfvz_holdings[wfvz_holdings$Scientific_name %in% unique(ku_bulcount$Var1), ]
str(wfvz_holdings)

#Priority list for KU
ku_priority_list <- read.csv("../data/Holdings/KU_priority_list.csv")
str(ku_priority_list)

#Now only keep species present in the wfvz_holdings data frame in the ku_priority_list data frame
ku_priority_list <- ku_priority_list[ku_priority_list$Species %in% unique(wfvz_holdings$Scientific_name), ]
str(ku_priority_list)

#Replace the Specimen.count.in.KU.collections column in the ku_priority_list data frame with the count of specimens per species in the wfvz_bulcount data frame, matching by scientific name
ku_priority_list$Specimen.count.in.KU.collections <- wfvz_bulcount[ku_priority_list$Species]
str(ku_priority_list)

#Store the updated priority list as a csv file
write.csv(ku_priority_list, "../data/Holdings/WFVZ_priority_list.csv")

setdiff(
  unique(ku_priority_list$Species),
  unique(wfvz_holdings$Scientific_name)
)

setdiff(
  unique(wfvz_holdings$Scientific_name),
  unique(ku_priority_list$Species)
)
```
